name: Members: Sign-in link and Remove dialogs

accessibility: The link field is read-only and labelled for assistive technology; Remove is a danger-styled action named by its words, and the dialog description says what will happen.
constraints: Built only from Adapter Widgets (Panel dialog, Stack, TextInput, Button); no Widget outside the Adapter catalog.
The sign-in link shown is a made-up sample, never a real invite; its expiry sentence is a baked sample per Locale because the date is not a Locale-key argument.
Every visible string is bound with $i18n except nicknames and the sample link; en-US and zh-TW keep identical key sets.
Visual language follows the Quiet Canvas design system in DESIGN.md.
entryConditions: A holder of members.manage chose Sign-in link (offered for people only) or Remove from a member's row menu on the Members page.
The base state is the sign-in link of jun; the Remove confirmation for dana is the Variant.
The render context selects one Workspace viewport preset, one Locale and one theme; the dialog is centered over a dimmed ground.
spec.intent: Show the two small dialogs of the Members page as built from Adapter Widgets only: the single-use sign-in link of a person, and the confirmation that removes a member.
interactionRules: The sign-in link is a single-use URL, shown in a read-only field with Copy; it names the person it signs in and when it expires, and an Agent is never offered one (it gets a Token).

Remove names the member and says its Tokens, sign-in links and sessions stop working at once while the records it wrote keep its name; Remove is the destructive action and Cancel leaves the roster alone.
